headline: Opus 5.5 sets an all-time share record at 4.2% while StepFun takes an 8.7-point tumble
summary: Anthropic's claude-opus-5.5 set a fresh all-time token share record at 4.2% and climbed three spots to No. 7, and z-ai/glm-5.3 set one too, at 4.0%. Meanwhile StepFun's step-5-preview fell four spots and shed 8.7 points of share, the biggest one-day provider swing in today's data.
highlights: claude-opus-5.5 posted an all-time token share record of 4.2%, a first-day record.
z-ai/glm-5.3 also set a fresh all-time token share record, at 4.0%.
DeepSeek still leads at 26.8% of provider share and gained 3.5 points on the day.
DeepSeek, Zhipu AI and Anthropic together hold 47.0% of token share.
StepFun's step-5-preview dropped four places and lost 8.7 points of share in a single day.
